AboutPage.intro_title: A modern platform founded in Uzbekistan
AboutPage.intro_description_1: — is a modern clothing platform founded in Uzbekistan, based on the ideas of simplicity, quality, and minimal design.
AboutPage.intro_description_2: The main goal of the platform is to shape a unique style by offering comfortable, modern, and aesthetically clean clothes for daily life.
AboutPage.vision_title: Choosing a style that stands the test of time
AboutPage.vision_description: The platform's idea relies on long-term value design, calm colors, and quality materials rather than noisy trends and fast-changing fashion.

features.minimalism_description: Expression of character through clear shapes and calm colors without excess decoration.
features.quality_description: Strict control of every product from selection to delivery to the customer.
features.future_description: Sustainable development starting in Uzbekistan and striving for an international scale.

AboutPage.growth_description_1: The platform was founded in Tashkent and operates within ABURIIX GROUP. The AKBW team pays special attention to design, quality control, and online sales processes.
AboutPage.growth_description_2: AKBW initially aims to strengthen its position in the market by cooperating with quality manufacturers. In the future, the platform plans to create products with its own design, fully reflecting the AKBW philosophy.

values.honesty_description: Transparency and trust are our top priorities in all our processes.
values.online_exp_description: An open, clear, and convenient shopping experience in the digital environment.

AboutPage.bottom_quote: AKBW is not just design, it's a way of thinking.
AboutPage.bottom_description: Express yourself through clear shapes and calm colors without excess decoration.

hero.title: Terms and Conditions
hero.subtitle: Rules and conditions for using the AKBW platform

TermsAndConditions.introduction: By using the platform, you agree to these terms and are obligated to follow them.

sections.title: 1. General Provisions
list: The platform provides online ordering and delivery services for clothing products.
The platform operates in accordance with the legislation of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
Ordering through the platform is only permitted for persons over 18 years of age.

sections.title: 2. Ordering Procedure
list: The user selects a product and places an order.
Information entered during ordering (name, phone, address) must be correct and accurate.
The platform is not responsible for orders not delivered due to incorrectly entered information.

sections.title: 3. Payment Terms
sections.content: Payments are made through the following methods:
notes: Payments are processed through secure third-party payment systems.
The platform does not store or process bank card details.

sections.title: 4. Delivery Terms
sections.content: Products are delivered through the BTS postal service, and delivery consists of two stages:

stages.title: Stage 1:
items: The product is delivered from abroad to Uzbekistan (Tashkent city).
This stage may take more time.
This time depends on customs, logistics, and external factors.

stages.title: Stage 2:
items: The product is sent from Tashkent to the address specified by the user via BTS.

sections.warning: The user understands and agrees that the delivery time mainly depends on Stage 1.

sections.title: 5. Delivery Time
sections.warning: The platform is not responsible for these cases.

sections.title: 6. Returns and Refunds
sections.note: the user must apply within 3 days of receiving the product.
additionalNotes: Return issues due to size or personal taste are considered individually.
Delivered and used products are not returnable.

sections.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
list: The platform is not fully responsible for the activities of third-party services (BTS, payment systems).
The platform is not responsible for damages caused by incorrect actions of the user.

sections.title: 8. Intellectual Property
list: All texts, images, and design elements on the site belong to the Platform.
Unauthorized copying or use of them is prohibited.

sections.title: 9. Changes
sections.content: The platform has the right to change these Terms of Use at any time.
sections.note: Updated terms become effective from the day they are posted on the site.
